title: Composable Data Stack Compatibility Registry
description: Central, non-scattered record of module pairings for a given contract that are known to have been tested together, or explicitly known NOT to work together. This is deliberately separate from plain contract `kind` matching (structural compatibility): an entry here expresses practical, known-good/known-bad compatibility, not just shape compatibility. Absence of an entry for a pairing means 'not yet recorded' -- it is neither tested nor unsupported.

contract.description: Contract kind this pairing applies to (matches a module's provides[].contract.kind / consumes[].contract.kind).

provider.description: Providing module's identity, as "<metadata.category>/<metadata.name>" (e.g. "warehouse/postgres"). Stable across profiles, unlike a profile-scoped module instance id or a source path.

status.description: "tested": this exact provider/consumer pairing for this contract has been exercised together (e.g. by a profile under active CI coverage) and is known-good. "unsupported": this pairing is structurally compatible (same contract kind) but has been found NOT to work together in practice; validation reports this as an error.

notes.description: Free-text context, e.g. which profile/test exercises a "tested" pairing, or why an "unsupported" pairing fails.
